title: [E16-03] Seeded End-to-End Business and Failure Regression Suite
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E16-03 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/17

**User Story:**
As a engineer, I want to run smoke e2e on complete seeded journey, so I can catch regressions.

**Epic:** E16 — Architecture, security, tests, deployment & operations  
**Domain:** Infrastructure / Security / QA  
**Type:** Test / Validation  
**Priority:** P0  
**Target Release:** B — Competition prototype — 10 December 2026  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 5 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Engineering/QA  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** US-043, US-044  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P0`, `release:B`, `epic:E16`, `infrastructure`, `security`, `qa`

**Dependencies:** [E15-02](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/188), [E15-04](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/190), [E08-02](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/56), [E09-01](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/58), [E10-03](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/144)
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: —; additional proposed blockers: E15-02, E15-04, E08-02, E09-01, E10-03.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Order, offer, inspection, simulated settlement and reset pass.
- [ ] Exercise one order from RFQ through quote, offers, progress, QA, shipment and simulated payment.
- [ ] Verify decline/reallocation, excess quantity, rejected-unit shipping and duplicate payment protections.
- [ ] Run role/tenant denial cases and deterministic reset.
- [ ] Produce repeatable CI results with fixture version and useful failure artifacts.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Use browser/API integration tests against isolated seeded services; mock external providers and never move real money.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Run clean-state happy/failure journeys twice and confirm consistent totals and no residual test data across scenarios.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.

**Release Boundary:** Use isolated synthetic commercial records and distinguish simulation, observed evidence and physical hardware. This story does not authorize real contracts or live money movement.
